'''Joseph Hinman Wieskamp''' (born August 23, 1999) is an American professional [[basketball]] player for [[Alba Berlin]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL). He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball|Iowa Hawkeyes]] before being drafted 41st overall in the [[2021 NBA draft]] by the [[San Antonio Spurs]].

==Early life==
In middle school, Wieskamp played [[American football|football]] as a [[quarterback]] and was a talented [[baseball]] player. He quit football after breaking his thumb and eventually decided to focus solely on basketball.<ref name="coss">{{cite web |last1=Coss |first1=Matt |title=Going places: Iowa recruit Wieskamp blossoms into elite talent |url=https://qctimes.com/sports/high-school/basketball/boys/going-places-iowa-recruit-wieskamp-blossoms-into-elite-talent/article_04a8e1cc-b90f-5216-8063-2132382587d9.html |website=[[Quad-City Times]] |accessdate=December 16, 2019 |date=December 4, 2016}}</ref> Wieskamp played basketball for [[Muscatine High School]] in his hometown of [[Muscatine, Iowa]]. In his freshman season, he averaged 18.6 points per game, which made him the top scoring freshman in Iowa.<ref name="cuellar">{{cite web |last1=Cuellar |first1=Chris |title=Meet Joe Wieskamp: Muscatine's young hoops star set to join Hawkeyes in '18 |url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/sports/basketball/2015/07/04/joe-wieskamp-muscatine-high-school-iowa-hawkeyes-basketball/29712349/ |website=[[The Des Moines Register]] |accessdate=December 16, 2019 |date=July 4, 2015}}</ref> Wieskamp became the first freshman in [[Mississippi Athletic Conference]] (MAC) history to earn all-conference honors. In his sophomore season, he averaged 21.6 points and 10 rebounds per game and was named first-team all-state.<ref name=coss/>

As a junior, Wieskamp averaged 30.4 points and 10.2 rebounds per game and was recognized as MAC Player of the Year. He became the first Iowa Class 4A player to average 30 points since [[Jeff Horner]] in 2002.<ref name="lensing">{{cite web |last1=Lensing |first1=Jeremy |title=Wieskamp named MAC Player of the Year, 1 of 3 Muskies honors |url=https://muscatinejournal.com/sports/high-school/wieskamp-named-mac-player-of-the-year-of-muskies-honors/article_a89c56b2-c742-534b-808e-727189f95869.html |website=[[Muscatine Journal]] |accessdate=December 16, 2019 |date=March 6, 2017}}</ref> Wieskamp scored a school-record 50 points in a win over [[Burlington High School (Iowa)|Burlington High School]] to become Muscatine's all-time leading scorer.<ref name="bain">{{cite web |last1=Bain |first1=Matthew |title=Hawkeye commit scores 50, breaks two school records |url=https://www.hawkcentral.com/story/sports/college/iowa/basketball-men/2016/12/13/hawkeye-commit-joe-wieskamp-scores-50-breaks-two-school-records/95410150/ |website=Hawk Central |accessdate=December 16, 2019 |date=December 13, 2016}}</ref> He was voted Iowa [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade Player of the Year]].<ref name="goodwin">{{cite web |last1=Goodwin |first1=Cody |title=Meet The Des Moines Register's All-Iowa boys' basketball team |url=https://www.desmoinesregister.com/story/sports/high-school/all-iowa/2017/03/24/all-iowa-boys-basketball-team-2017-des-moines-register/99510888/ |website=[[The Des Moines Register]] |accessdate=December 16, 2019 |date=March 24, 2017}}</ref> As a senior, Wieskamp averaged a state-high 33.5 points and 13.5 rebounds per game, leading his team to its first state tournament in 16 years.<ref>{{cite web |title=Photos: Joe Wieskamp through the years |url=https://qctimes.com/sports/basketball/college/big-10/iowa/photos-joe-wieskamp-through-the-years/collection_8be0a3ec-0ad5-11ea-8720-ebf2e8c9b790.html |website=[[Quad-City Times]] |accessdate=December 16, 2019 |date=November 21, 2019}}</ref> He repeated as Iowa Gatorade Player of the Year and was named [[Iowa Mr. Basketball]]. Wieskamp left high school as the Iowa Class 4A career scoring leader, with 2,376 points.<ref name="coss2">{{cite web |last1=Coss |first1=Matt |title=Muskies' Wieskamp is 2018 Iowa Mr. Basketball |url=https://qctimes.com/sports/high-school/basketball/boys/muskies-wieskamp-is-iowa-mr-basketball/article_a623eb89-7cbc-59bb-a921-4d44d8fcee0c.html |website=[[Quad-City Times]] |accessdate=December 16, 2019 |date=March 13, 2018}}</ref>

Wieskamp committed to play [[college basketball]] for [[Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball|Iowa]] on June 9, 2015, before his sophomore year. At the end of his high school career, he was considered a consensus four-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and the best prospect in Iowa.<ref name=cuellar/>

==College career==
[[File:Joe Wieskamp.jpg|thumb|upright|Wieskamp with [[Iowa Hawkeyes men's basketball|Iowa]] in 2019]]
On January 20, 2019, Wieskamp went 8-for-8 from the floor and scored a season-high 24 points in a 95–71 win over [[Illinois Fighting Illini men's basketball|Illinois]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Wieskamp scores 24, No. 23 Iowa routs Illinois 95–71 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap?gameId=401082348 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |agency=[[Associated Press]] |accessdate=December 26, 2019 |date=January 20, 2019}}</ref> Wieskamp had 19 points and five rebounds against [[Cincinnati Bearcats men's basketball|Cincinnati]] in the NCAA tournament. As a freshman he averaged 11.1 points and 4.9 rebounds per game, shooting 42.4 percent from beyond the arc. He started all 35 games and was named to the [[Big Ten Conference|Big Ten]] All-freshman team.<ref name=leap/> After the season he declared for the [[2019 NBA draft]] but did not hire an agent.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.thegazette.com/subject/sports/hawkeyes/iowa-mens-basketball/joe-wieskamp-enters-nba-draft-will-he-return-to-iowa-basketball-20190411 |title=Iowa's Joe Wieskamp enters NBA Draft, not hiring agent |website=[[The Gazette (Cedar Rapids)|The Gazette]] |accessdate=December 26, 2019 |date=April 11, 2019}}</ref> Wieskamp ultimately decided to withdraw from the draft and return to Iowa.<ref>{{cite web |title=University of Iowa's Joe Wieskamp withdraws name from NBA Draft |url=https://www.kcrg.com/content/news/Wieskamp-Withdraws-From-NBA-Draft-510279221.html |publisher=KCRG |accessdate=December 26, 2019 |date=May 22, 2019}}</ref>

==Professional career==
===San Antonio Spurs (2021–2022)===
On July 29, 2021, Wieskamp was drafted with the 41st overall pick in the [[2021 NBA draft]] by the [[San Antonio Spurs]].<ref>{{Cite web|last=Orsborn|first=Tom|date=July 30, 2021|title=Spurs select former Iowa sharpshooter Joe Wieskamp in second round|url=https://www.expressnews.com/sports/spurs/article/Spurs-select-former-Iowa-sharpshooter-Joe-16351121.php|access-date=July 31, 2021|website=[[San Antonio Express-News]]}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=SPURS SELECT JOSHUA PRIMO AND JOE WIESKAMP IN 2021 NBA DRAFT|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-select-joshua-primo-and-joe-wieskamp-2021-nba-draft|date=July 29, 2021|publisher=National Basketball Association|access-date=July 31, 2021}}</ref> He joined the Spurs for the [[2021 NBA Summer League]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Spurs announce 2021 Summer League roster|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/spurs-announce-2021-summer-league-roster|date=August 1, 2021|publisher=National Basketball Association|accessdate=August 1, 2021}}</ref> On September 7, he signed a [[two-way contract]] with the Spurs, splitting his time between San Antonio and their [[NBA G League]] affiliate, the [[Austin Spurs]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Spurs sign Joe Wieskamp to two-way contract|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-sign-joe-wieskamp-two-way-contract|date=September 7, 2021|publisher=National Basketball Association|accessdate=September 7, 2021}}</ref> On November 10, he made his [[NBA]] debut, scoring 3 points off the bench in a 136–117 win over the [[Sacramento Kings]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Murray scores 26, Spurs hit 18 3s to blitz Kings 136–117|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap?gameId=401359990|date=November 10, 2021|publisher=ESPN|accessdate=November 10, 2021}}</ref> On March 4, 2022, his contract was converted to a standard contract.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/players/transactions|publisher=National Basketball Association|title=NBA Transactions|date=March 4, 2022|access-date=March 4, 2022}}</ref>

On August 24, 2022, Wieskamp re-signed with the Spurs,<ref>{{Cite web |title=SPURS RE-SIGN JOE WIESKAMP |url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-re-sign-joe-wieskamp |access-date=September 25, 2022 |publisher=National Basketball Association |language=en}}</ref> but was later waived on October 17, 2022.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.nba.com/spurs/news/spurs-finalize-opening-night-roster|title=Spurs finalize opening night roster|date=October 17, 2022|publisher=National Basketball Association|access-date=October 17, 2022}}</ref>

===Wisconsin Herd (2022)===
On October 22, 2022, Wieskamp was selected second overall in [[2022 NBA G League draft]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://pr.nba.com/2022-23-nba-g-league-draft-results|title=Charge select Sam Merrill with first pick of 2022–23 NBA G League Draft|date=October 22, 2022|publisher=National Basketball Association|access-date=October 22, 2022}}</ref> On November 3, Wieskamp was named to the opening night roster for the [[Wisconsin Herd]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.oursportscentral.com/services/releases/wisconsin-herd-announces-2022-23-opening-day-roster/n-5895537|title=Wisconsin Herd Announces 2022–23 Opening Day Roster|website=oursportscentral.com|date=November 3, 2022|access-date=November 3, 2022}}</ref>

===Toronto Raptors (2023)===
On January 7, 2023, Wieskamp signed a 10-day contract with the [[Toronto Raptors]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Raptors sign Wieskamp to 10-day contract |url=https://www.nba.com/raptors/news/raptors-sign-wieskamp-to-10-day-contract |access-date=January 7, 2023 |publisher=National Basketball Association |language=en}}</ref> He was signed to a second 10-day contract on January 17.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Raptors Sign Wieskamp To Second 10-Day Contract |url=https://gleague.nba.com/news/raptors-sign-wieskamp-to-second-10-day-contract |access-date=January 28, 2023 |website=NBA G League}}</ref> On January 19, he saw his first action for the Raptors and went 3-of-3 from 3-pointers in a 128–126 loss to the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Russell scores 16 points in 4th, Wolves beat Raptors 128-126|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401468835|publisher=ESPN|date=January 19, 2023|access-date=July 9, 2024}}</ref> On January 27, Wieskamp was reacquired by the Herd.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://gleague.nba.com/22-23-nba-g-league-transactions|publisher=National Basketball Association|title=2022–23 NBA G League Transactions|date=January 27, 2023|access-date=January 27, 2023}}</ref> On February 11, he signed a multi-year contract with the Raptors.<ref name=infotel>{{cite web|title=Raptors waive guard-forward Joe Wieskamp|url=https://infotel.ca/newsitem/bkn-raptors-moves/cp86933987|website=infotel.ca|date=July 17, 2023|access-date=July 9, 2024}}</ref> He appeared in nine games for the Raptors in the [[2022–23 Toronto Raptors season|2022–23 season]].<ref name="infotel" />

On July 17, 2023, Wieskamp was waived by the Raptors following the [[2023 NBA Summer League|NBA Summer League]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Raptors waive guard/forward Joe Wieskamp following Summer League stint|url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/nba/raptors-waive-guard-forward-joe-wieskamp-following-summer-league-stint/sn-amp/|website=sportnet.ca|access-date=July 18, 2023}}</ref>

===Texas Legends (2023–2024)===
On August 14, 2023, Wieskamp signed with the [[Dallas Mavericks]],<ref>{{cite web|first=Eddie|last=Sefko|title=Mavericks sign three, including Fall Classic alumnus|url=https://www.mavs.com/mavs-sign-three/|website=Mavs.com|date=August 14, 2023|access-date=August 15, 2023}}</ref> but was waived on October 14.<ref>{{cite tweet|author=Mavs PR|title=The Dallas Mavericks announced today that they have waived guard Mike Miles Jr., guard Jordan Walker and guard/forward Joe Wieskamp.|number=1713251311309795778|user=MavsPR|date=October 14, 2023|access-date=October 15, 2023}}</ref> On October 29, he joined the [[Texas Legends]].<ref>{{cite web|first=Britney|last=Wynn|title=LEGENDS DRAFT FOUR, FINALIZE TRAINING CAMP ROSTER|url=https://texas.gleague.nba.com/news/legends-draft-four-finalize-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 29, 2023|access-date=December 14, 2023}}</ref>

===Maine Celtics (2024)===
On February 12, 2024, Wieskamp was acquired by the [[Maine Celtics]] in a three-team trade also including the [[Ontario Clippers]].<ref>{{cite web|first=Britney|last=Wynn|title=LEGENDS ACQUIRE WARITH ALATISHE IN THREE-TEAM TRADE|url=https://texas.gleague.nba.com/news/legends-acquire-warith-alatishe-in-three-team-trade|website=NBA.com|date=February 12, 2024|access-date=February 12, 2024}}</ref>

Wieskamp joined the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]] for the [[2024 NBA Summer League]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Timberwolves Announce NBA 2K25 Summer League 2024 in Las Vegas Roster|url=https://www.nba.com/timberwolves/news/timberwolves-announce-nba-2k25-summer-league-2024-in-las-vegas-roster|website=NBA.com|date=July 7, 2024|access-date=July 9, 2024}}</ref>

===South East Melbourne Phoenix (2024–2025)===
On July 8, 2024, Wieskamp signed with the [[South East Melbourne Phoenix]] of the Australian [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL) for the [[2024–25 NBL season|2024–25 season]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Phoenix Add Second Import Joe Wieskamp for NBL25|url=https://www.semphoenix.com.au/news/phoenix-add-second-import-joe-wieskamp-for-nbl25|website=NBL.com.au|date=July 8, 2024|access-date=July 9, 2024}}</ref>

===Science City Jena (2025–2026)===
On July 29, 2025, he signed with [[Science City Jena]] of [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.baskets-jena.de/news/tickets/ein-hauch-nba-an-der-saale-science-city-jena-verpflichtet-fluegel-joe-wieskamp|title=Ein Hauch NBA an der Saale - Science City Jena verpflichtet Flügelspieler Joe Wieskamp|last=|first=|date=July 29, 2025|website=baskets-jena.de|publisher=|language=de|access-date=October 2, 2025}}</ref>

===Alba Berlin (2026–present)===
On July 20, 2026, he signed with [[Alba Berlin]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]] (BBL).<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.albaberlin.de/news/details/effektivster-bbl-spieler-2025-26-alba-verpflichtet-us-forward-joe-wieskamp-fuer-drei-jahre|title=Effektivster BBL-Spieler 2025/26: ALBA verpflichtet US-Forward Joe Wieskamp für drei Jahre|date=July 20, 2026|website=albaberlin.de|publisher=|language=de|access-date=July 25, 2026}}</ref> He signed a three-year contract.<ref>{{cite web |title=Joe Wieskamp inks three-year contract with ALBA Berlin: “I’m excited” |url=https://www.eurohoops.net/en/fiba-champions-league/1992907/joe-wieskamp-to-alba-berlin-basketball-champions-league/ |website=Eurohoops |access-date=28 July 2026 |language=en |date=21 July 2026}}</ref>
